Dear Akakaku Bomb, Nice to meet you. I'm Sun La Mall, a VTuber active on YouTube. After seeing the illustrations you accepted via Skeb, I'd very much like you to create artwork for my VTuber activities and am submitting this request.

【Usage Purposes】 ① Posting and use on various SNS (e.g., for "Good Morning VTuber" posts, weekly schedule posts, etc. / Use for icons, headers, etc.) ② Posting on my website (lit.link) ③ Use for stream thumbnails, waiting screens, and end cards (on monetized channels)
④ Use of the illustration during streams and in videos. ⑤ Use as benefits for paid fan club members, including fan club thumbnails, etc. ⑥ Commercial use for digital goods/physical goods, etc. ※ For some uses, this may include placing text over the image, cropping, or light editing to blend the image (e.g., adding a white border, applying a faint overlay) without distorting the original form. ※ When using the illustration, we will always clearly credit the creator.


【Appearance Details】 Please refer to the reference materials (including three-view diagrams) at the URL below. 【Other Requests】 All expressions and compositions are left entirely to your discretion. Providing PSD files or transparent background files for the character alone would be helpful. Additionally, to facilitate thumbnail use, we would appreciate it if you could draw the character so the top of the head (and ideally the left and right sides of the body) are not cropped off.

These are merely requests; there is no obligation to comply. We would be grateful if you could create the artwork according to your convenience, Akakado Bomb-sama. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your consideration. https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ckNdO13JkVBEom8EuKSzvHuBsJQvJIFw?usp=drive_link

Hello, my name is Oruoto Chirukuma, and I stream on Twitch and YouTube.
I saw your illustration on X. I thought your illustration was very cute and colorful with a sense of American comics, so I made a request!
If you don't mind, could you please draw me an OC to be used in the activity?

Request details
I would like you to draw Oruo Scattered Bear (OC).
I would appreciate it if you could draw it without the head cut off, as it may be used as a thumbnail.

If you are not sure about the motif, please refer to the following.
Teddy bear, rice, salmon, sweets (Japanese or Western)

Usage:
(1)Use in distribution activities (use on various social networking sites)
(2)Use on Twitch/YouTube (thumbnails, cover art, OP/ED, etc.)
We will never add directly to illustrations, but there is a possibility that text or processing may be covered.

Delivery format
We would appreciate it if you could provide us with PSD data in which the person and background are layered.

Remarks
We are sorry that we do not have a three-view plan, but we would appreciate it if you could draw it referring to the following data.
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1sLizfzeRtHwgfAkQ90y1iAIwomYAcnet/view?usp=drive_link
(I have drawn #Chill on the badge.)
If there are any parts that are difficult to understand, you are free to change them! (The artist has given us permission to do so.)

If there is any problem, you can change or cancel everything!
Thank you very much in advance for your cooperation.
